mapper.sql: id, segment_id, source_type, source_id, severity, description, found_at, status, handle_note, resolved_by, resolved_at, created_at

FROM risk_event r JOIN tunnel_segment s ON s.id = r.segment_id LEFT JOIN patrol_point p ON r.source_type = '巡检点' AND p.id = r.source_id LEFT JOIN facility f ON r.source_type = '附属设备' AND f.id = r.source_id

r.id, r.segment_id, r.source_type, r.source_id, r.severity, r.description, r.found_at, r.status, r.handle_note, r.resolved_by, r.resolved_at, r.created_at, s.seg_code, s.seg_name, COALESCE(p.point_code, f.facility_type) AS source_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO risk_event (segment_id, source_type, source_id, severity, description, found_at, status, handle_note, resolved_by, resolved_at, created_at) VALUES (#{segmentId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{severity}, #{description}, #{foundAt}, #{status}, #{handleNote}, #{resolvedBy}, #{resolvedAt}, UTC_TIMESTAMP())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM risk_event WHERE segment_id = #{segmentId} AND status != '已解除'

SELECT
WHERE r.segment_id = #{segmentId} AND r.status != '已解除' ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE risk_event SET status = '已解除', handle_note = #{handleNote}, resolved_by = #{resolvedBy}, resolved_at = #{resolvedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('待处置', '处理中')
